map.CRF 与固定码率（-b:v）怎么选？: How to choose between CRF and fixed bitrate (-b:v)?
map.CRF 恒定质量、文件大小随画面复杂度浮动，适合归档/一次性导出；固定码率（-b: CRF gives constant quality and the file size floats with scene complexity, suiting archiving and one-off exports; fixed bitrate (-b:v) locks the size precisely, suiting strict size limits (such as platform caps). This tool provides both commands; CRF defaults to 23 (H.264) / 28 (H.265), and smaller values mean higher quality and larger files.
map.H.265/HEVC 用更高效的帧间/帧内预测，同等主观画质下码率比 H.264: H.265/HEVC uses more efficient inter- and intra-frame prediction, giving a bitrate about 30–50% lower than H.264 at the same subjective quality; but encoding takes longer, and some older phones and browsers do not support hardware decoding. H.264 is the safest for mainstream platforms; use H.265 when you want to save bandwidth or archive 4K.
